descriptions.value: As part of Cisco's ongoing commitment to proactive security and product quality, Cisco has conducted a comprehensive internal security review. This review resulted in a software hardening release that addresses multiple internally discovered vulnerabilities. The vulnerabilities tracked by CVE-2026-76529 are related to improper protection of alternate path and are grouped under the Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) CWE-424.

descriptions.description: The product does not sufficiently protect all possible paths that a user can take to access restricted functionality or resources.

assertions.title: Improper Protection of Alternate Path in Splunk SOAR

title: Improper Protection of Alternate Path in Splunk SOAR

descriptions.value: Access of resource using incompatible type ('type confusion') in Microsoft Edge (Chromium-based) allows an unauthorized attacker to disclose information over a network.
